Michael Schumacher won the French Grand Prix at Magny-Cours four times (2001, 2002, 2004, 2006). The other winners were David Coulthard (2000), Ralf Schumacher (2003), Fernando Alonso (2005), Kimi Räikkönen (2007) and Felipe Massa (2008), each with one win.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
